reasons: CS4236 is offered only in Sem 1, so with Sem 7 as LOA it must be in Sem 5.
CS3242 in Sem 6 requires CS3241 and PC1201 in Sem 5, and CS2102 must precede CS3242.
Sem 5 would need 16 MC, exceeding the 12 MC per-semester limit.
